name_reason: Compliant with global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix, chapter domain, ch18 is a valid chapter domain ID (01-30, must be preserved -- not Ghidra address residue), and end_scene_char_pos_x_table clearly reflects both purpose (per-character X tile coordinates for the chapter-18 end scene) and data type (lookup table). No address residue in the name.
purpose: Read-only per-character X tile-coordinate lookup table for the chapter 18 (Distant Shore / 遙遠的彼岸) end scene; supplies the pos_x placement block for fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro.
logic_summary: Sole consumer fd2_chapter_18_end (@0x23CED) copies all 17 bytes onto its stack (4x dword copy via the iVar1=4 loop = MOVSD x4, plus a trailing single-byte copy for the 17th element) into a local block and passes &block as the 1st (pos_x) argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro. That helper indexes the block [char_idx] one byte per char (stride 1) and stores each into runtime_char.bPos_x. No element scaling; flat uint8 access.
element_semantics: Each element is the battle-tile X coordinate (column) for one character slot in the chapter-18 end-scene placement; 17 entries cover the chars placed by the handler. Values 15..25 (tile columns). Unsigned byte, stride 1.
notes: Memory bytes (17) at 0x521C3 are byte-identical to the C definition: 22,22,21,21,21,21,20,20,20,20,22,23,24,22,23,24,25. Only xref is fd2_chapter_18_end (READ @0x23CF2, DATA @0x23CED); no writers -> const confirmed. Existing C comment (chtab2.c lines 149-160) is accurate and precise (17 bytes, MOVSD x4 + MOVSB tail, indexed per-char into runtime_char.bPos_x, read-only, bounded by adjacent pos_y_table @0x521D4) -> comment kept unchanged, no Edit to src. Ghidra data plate was null -> created a concise plate (PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline) reflecting the src conclusion. Name kept (Stage-2 rename not needed).
